versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the desgin skill for frontend UI design in Angular, React, and Blazor.
- Provides mobile-first, framework-agnostic design principles and process.
- Includes step-by-step workflow for designing responsive interfaces and scaling up breakpoints.
- Offers core quality standards for accessibility, typography, spacing, and usability.
- Lists actionable commands and anti-patterns to guide UI/UX improvements.
- Comprehensive references for framework conventions, layout, accessibility, and more.
